audience: developers and maintainers who follow projects, merge requests and pipelines on gitlab.com

useCases.title: Review open merge requests
useCases.text: List the merge requests of a project, filtered by state. Read one by its iid to see its branches, reviewers and merge status.

useCases.title: Find failed pipelines on a branch
useCases.text: List the pipelines of a project, filtered by status or branch. Read the jobs of one pipeline to see which stage failed.

useCases.title: Triage open issues
useCases.text: List the issues of a project, filtered by state or labels. Read one issue and its comments, oldest first by default.

useCases.title: Open an issue with a description and labels
useCases.text: Create a new issue in a project with a title, an optional description and optional labels.

useCases.title: Add a status comment to an issue
useCases.text: Add a comment to an existing issue, for example a status update.
